Table 3.1. The eleven organ systems in the human body and their major functions 
An organism is the highest level of organization—a complete living system capable of conducting 
all of life’s biological processes. In multicellular organisms, including humans, all cells, tissues, organs, 
and organ systems of the body work together to maintain the life and health of the organism.
